validation.timing_note: Fixture runs alternate G0/G1 order across three repeats. Droop and DR repeats are serial grouped runs. All use quiet GPU guards; setup/compilation/diagnostics/rendering are not simulation cost. Physical measures are bounded diagnostics, not general convergence or equal-accuracy ranking.
validation.fixture_api_migration: Deprecated rod geometry spellings translated to current newton.Rod assembly; frozen legacy point/frame generation, no solver/collision replacement. Current G0/G1 models match. Historical initial-pose hash changes are disclosed separately, so old G0 is not reused as a current baseline.

slinky.interpretation: Authored metric reopens whenever top-bottom separation exceeds0.3m, including after landing. Independent diagnostic latches the first closure or first ground contact; applies identically to every G0/G1 record. This is an event-window correction, not a solver/physics change or validation of continuum wave propagation. Original metrics/failures remain intact; threshold stays0.1m.

scope: Full-step wall cost includes collision where enabled, assembly, all local/global work, dispatch, refresh/recapture and synchronization. Setup, compilation, authored diagnostics, saved-state audits and rendering are separate. Cost is mean [min,max] of three run means, not a confidence interval. Geometry tables and videos use the preselected first repeat; all repeated physical measurements are retained in provenance.
publication_scope: Report-only: no solver source, internal competitor code or private comparison report.
